summary: Instinct bridge, PR 1 (contract and durable records), behind the staged flag instinct_bridge (INSTINCT_BRIDGE_ENABLED in src/shared/bridge.ts, false; SB_INSTINCT_BRIDGE=1 or the backend setting labs.instinct_bridge turns it on; no capability is advertised until the tools ship). src/shared/bridge.ts holds the wire version (1), the seven tool names (search_chats, list_projects, list_recent_chats, start_chat, send_to_chat, read_chat, stop_chat), the three mutating operations, the project policy {project_id, label, machine_id, canonical_local_root, allowed_agents, default_agent, default_model, default_mode, maximum_mode, actions} with defaults auto capped at auto, edit and checks on, commit, push, PR, merge and deploy off, the public project view without the local root, the opaque chat reference {machine_id, chat_id}, the call delivery, chat work, stop and evidence states, the 19 error codes with a structured error and retry advice, the mode check that refuses a mode above the cap instead of changing it, and a canonical input hash for idempotency. An additive migration adds bridge_project_policies (with a revision raised on each save), bridge_calls (unique on operation and idempotency key, with input hash, call id, machine, resolved target, policy revision, state, rejection detail and timestamps; after 90 days a tombstone keeps key, hash and call id, and its key answers request_retired), bridge_origins (one per root chat, resolved through resolveRootThreadId, stamped with the stop generation) and bridge_stop_generation (one monotonic row). src/main/db/bridge.ts reserves calls in an immediate transaction under the call id the relay reserved (or a new one for a local call), moves call states only forward, retires expired calls, recovers calls caught mid-flight at start (recorded becomes rejected with confirmed non-delivery, dispatching becomes delivery_unknown), records and reads origins and reads and advances the stop generation. Settings > Labs gains an Instinct bridge row with a warning that Instinct acts as the owner in allowed projects. Nothing calls these records yet: no relay, no tools and no executable bridge path ship in this part. PR 2 (local read tools): with the flag on, Settings > Labs lists the sidebar projects with a checkbox each (none checked by default); a checked project is saved as a bridge policy under its realpath with the default policy, on this desktop's machine id (the existing hub.installId row), through the admin-scoped bridge:list-projects and bridge:set-project-allowed channels. The Switchboard MCP server gives every local agent list_projects, list_recent_chats, search_chats and read_chat (src/main/bridge/read-service.ts, src/main/mcp/bridge-tools.ts), listed only while the flag is on and refused with bridge_disabled once it is off. The allowlist is applied in SQL before ranking and limits on both the FTS and the fallback message-search path; title matches merge with message hits into one row per root chat (matched_on title, message or both) under the existing word-prefix and archive-word rules; snippets are plain text of at most 240 characters with saved secrets masked; read_chat returns measured status, the latest reply with a partial marker while a turn runs, pending questions and approvals, a bounded masked history window and an opaque since cursor bound to chat, machine and policy revision (unchanged: true or cursor_expired); labels resolve exact id, then exact normalized label, then bounded word-prefix fuzzy, and several plausible matches give ambiguous_target with choices. No answer carries a local path. Results are local only (partial false, no unavailable machines) and evidence is not_measured until the measured-check service. Global search is unchanged. PR 3 (owner delivery): with the flag on the Switchboard MCP server also gives every local agent start_chat, send_to_chat and stop_chat (src/main/bridge/delivery-service.ts), each with an idempotency_key. A call is reserved under (operation, caller-scoped key) with its input hash before any provider action; the same key and body answers from the record (replayed: true), another body gives idempotency_conflict. start_chat resolves an allowed project, refuses a mode above min(policy cap, caller mode) with mode_not_allowed and an agent or model the project does not offer with agent_unavailable and choices, allows one active bridge group per machine (policy_denied while a bridge chat runs or starts), stores the chat, its mode and model and its bridge origin before the provider starts, starts it through startManagedSession and sends the first message through the durable atomic user-turn acceptance with origin bridge-<call id>, so a retry after a crash finds the accepted turn and its message id and sends nothing again. send_to_chat refuses archived chats (chat_archived), open hub children (child_read_only), a chat in a mode wider than the cap and the calling chat itself, resumes a dormant chat through the normal start (else chat_not_resumable), records the bridge origin on the chat and applies peerDelivery: queue by default, steer only when asked, supported and not compacting or stopping, with requested and actual delivery in the answer. stop_chat (allowed from plan mode) fences any start or send of that chat still in flight, takes back the bridge's queued messages only and runs the user's Stop (interrupt, auto-resume disarmed), answering stopping, stopped or stop_unconfirmed. The execution root is realpathed under the policy root before each mutation. A plan-mode caller cannot start or send. No card is shown and the started chat keeps its own approvals and plan mode; nothing goes through the agent peer gate. bridge_calls gains an additive result column (actual delivery, stop status).

desktop.followUpRelease: bridge-v2.1: the release that ships the relay connection, the seven tools and the stop controls (bridge PRs 2 to 8) and keeps instinct_bridge off by default until the owner trial on both computers passes. PR 2 added the allowlist setup in Settings > Labs and the four read tools for local agents; PR 3 adds start_chat, send_to_chat and stop_chat for local agents.

reactNativeIos.reason: The read and delivery tools are desktop MCP tools for local agents and the allowlist setup is desktop only (admin-scoped bridge:* channels a phone credential cannot call). Normal chats, their lists and their messages on the phone are unchanged: a chat the bridge starts or messages is an ordinary managed chat with ordinary user turns, so it shows on the phone through the existing flows. Later bridge PRs add bridge-origin, evidence and stop-pending presentation to the phone, with management staged behind instinct_bridge_phone_controls for bridge-v2.1.

updateRelease.followUpRelease: bridge-v2.1. PR 1's migration is additive (four new tables) and PR 2 adds no migration and PR 3 adds one nullable column (bridge_calls.result, added only when missing): policies go in the PR 1 table and the machine id reuses the existing hub.installId settings row. The flag stays off by default and advertises no capability.

automated: tests/unit/bridge-delivery-service.test.ts (createMigratedDb, the real AtomicUserTurnSubmission and SqliteTurnAcceptanceStore, a fake registry host): start stores the chat, mode and origin before the start and sends one atomic first turn; same key and body replays without a second send, a changed body is idempotency_conflict, another caller's key is separate; mode cap from policy and caller, plan callers refused; agent and model choices; project off the allowlist; bridge_disabled with the flag off on all three; one active bridge group with sends into that chat still accepted; a stop during the start fences it (no turn sent, call rejected with confirmed non-delivery); a crash after the provider took the turn replays the same message id with no second dispatch, a turn left dispatching stays delivery_unknown, a call never dispatched is rejected; idle send is a turn, busy send queues by default, steers when asked, queues while compacting and on an ACP agent; dormant chat resumes through startSession or answers chat_not_resumable; a rotated id reaches the root and submits on the live rotated thread; archived, open child, wider chat mode, moved execution root and the calling chat are refused; a pending approval stays open and read_chat shows it after a send; stop takes back only bridge-queued messages, runs the Stop once, replays as stopped, and a failing Stop is stop_unconfirmed; the MCP tools list seven names and refuse with isError.

tests/unit/bridge-read-service.test.ts (createMigratedDb): the allowlist starts empty, saves the default policy under the realpath and ignores another machine's policy; title-only, message-only and both hits give one row per root chat (a rotated session's hit joins its root); the allowlist applies before the limit on the FTS path and, with messages_fts dropped, on the fallback path; archived chats only with the archive word; an empty index answers empty lists; snippets are plain, at most 240 characters, and mask a saved secret; recent chats order by message time and live activity, not metadata; project and chat labels resolve exactly, fuzzily and as ambiguous_target with choices; a chat outside the allowlist or on another machine is refused; read_chat returns status, latest reply with partial, pending questions and not_measured evidence; the since cursor gives unchanged, then only new messages, and cursor_expired for another chat, a forged cursor and a policy change; no answer holds the project folder path.

tests/unit/secret-request-registry.test.ts (real registry): the four tools are not listed with instinct_bridge off, are listed read-only with it on, and a call after it turns off answers bridge_disabled; bridge:* channels are refused for PHONE_SCOPES and allowed for FULL_SCOPES.
tests/unit/labs-page.test.ts: the project list appears only after the Instinct bridge switch is on, and a checkbox calls setProjectAllowed and shows the saved state.
Existing message-search tests (message-search-contract, message-search-query) stay green: global search passes no project scope.
PR 1 tests (bridge-db, bridge-contract, labs) unchanged and green.
npm run typecheck and npx vitest run --maxWorkers=2 pass.
